name: [R9] LLM/agent egress to a non-allowlisted domain (possible IDPI)
message:
An LLM/agent process (identified by user agent) sent data to a domain outside the approved allowlist. This is a behavioral proxy for web-based indirect prompt injection (IDPI) steering the agent's output elsewhere, per Unit 42's large-scale in-the-wild IDPI telemetry study (2026-03-03) — it is not proof of IDPI on its own. Correlate with the agent's recent web-fetch activity and review the destination.

Tune: replace the allowlist with your own approved egress domains; scope user-agent matching to your actual agent stack.

queries.name: idpi_egress
queries.query: source:(proxy OR firewall) @http.useragent:(*python-requests* OR *node-fetch* OR *LangChain* OR *AutoGen* OR *CrewAI* OR *openclaw*) -@network.destination.name:(*.internal.example)
